title: Introducing Call Intelligence, Closing the Loop Between Sales Calls and Coaching
summary: Ambition's new Call Intelligence capability lets sales managers score Gong calls against their own methodology and send evaluations straight into coaching sessions.
body_markdown:
### Call Intelligence lets sales managers score calls against their own methodology and send evaluations straight into sessions


Today we're excited to introduce Call Intelligence, a new capability that brings Gong calls, transcripts, scorecards and trackers into Ambition, where revenue leaders already manage performance and coaching.


Scoring calls against your revenue organization’s specific criteria is crucial for understanding sales coaching effectiveness. Gong shows you what’s happening in sales calls, and Ambition turns those insights into actionable coaching that equips your reps to succeed.


Call Intelligence, which will expand to include additional call recorders in 2027, allows Ambition to ingest external-facing sales calls so managers can inspect and score them against a methodology or other custom rubric. A manager can then add elements of the scorecard directly into their next 1:1 agenda for discussion and coaching.


With Call Intelligence, managers can:


- **Define what good looks like.** Upload an existing rubric and Ambition's AI turns it into a scorecard, with editable sections, weights and grading guidance that teach the agent the team's definition of good. Managers can also start from an example or build from scratch.
- **See where each rep needs support.** Calls sync from Gong every hour with summaries, key moments, transcripts, and talk metrics. Managers can score any call with Ambition alongside existing Gong scores, compare up to three scorecards per call, and group calls by rep to spot patterns.
- **Bring it into the next 1:1.** With one click, managers send the call and its evaluation to the rep's upcoming coaching session, where it appears on the agenda ready to discuss and practice.


“Call Intelligence closes the feedback loop between sales calls and coaching conversations, so managers can see whether coaching actually shows up in real conversations,” said Jared Houghton, Ambition CEO & Cofounder. “It keeps your methodology front and center, side by side with every call transcript, and turns development opportunities into coaching moments in your next 1:1.”


“For teams already using Gong, Call Intelligence works alongside their existing scorecards and trackers, and allows for additional scorecards for sales methodology, custom rubrics, training, and more,” Houghton added. “I’m excited to expand Ambition’s focus on skills, behaviors, and rep performance to work in tandem with Gong’s strengths around calls and deals.”


To learn more,[get in touch with our team.](https://ambition.com/demo)
